name: AbsGS Gradient Densification
definition: A densification strategy that eliminates gradient collision by computing the homodirectional view-space positional gradient. It uses the absolute value of per-pixel gradient components before summing, ensuring all pixel contributions reinforce the magnitude rather than canceling out due to direction differences. This accurately identifies over-reconstructed Gaussians that standard gradient magnitude misses.
summary: AbsGS Gradient Densification is a 3D Gaussian Splatting strategy that eliminates gradient collision by summing absolute per-pixel gradient components, accurately identifying over-reconstructed Gaussians that standard methods miss.
